title: Cute replace
description: plugin for replace bad word in chat :D
body:
## Tired of foul-mouthed gnomes?  
### I’ve got the solution!

I developed this plugin for my Paper server on version 1.21.1 — it might also work on newer versions.

_The plugin was inspired by the Makoto server._

The plugin is very simple: after placing it into the plugins folder, a new folder named `CuteReplace` is created with 2 files:
- `replaced.yml`
- `mat.yml`

**mat.yml** — contains the swear words you want to filter out  
**replaced.yml** — contains the cute replacement words like "little fox", "caterpillar", etc.

That’s it! A very simple and lightweight plugin.

If you run into any issues, feel free to message me on Telegram! @AlexsandrDeveloper 
_(Also message me if you're interested in purchasing the plugin's source code)_
